title: Cloud City: Cheat Sheet: Cloud SQL vs AlloyDB vs Spanner vs Firestore vs Bigtable
city_concept: City Record Halls: Ledgers, Card Catalogs & Vaults

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: The city recorder stored tax audits, citizen birth certificates, and warehouse shipping tallies in the exact same wooden drawer.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Archivist Arthur established specialized archives: Bound Ledgers for taxes (Cloud SQL), The Master Vault for royal deeds (Spanner), and Tally Slates for cart weights (Bigtable).

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: Clerks retrieved tax records in seconds and weighed grain wagons without disturbing royal records.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Physical paper vaults can burn down; cloud databases replicate transactions synchronously across multiple availability zones.
